These externally hosted resources introduce skills relevant to using river chemistry and environmental data: finding observations, evaluating possible contaminant sources, and developing data-analysis and machine-learning workflows. They are teaching resources selected for the GRID community; they are not tutorials for a specific GRID release.

Each entry identifies the audience, estimated effort, tools, creators, and original host. Follow the host link for the complete activity, module, or course and its access requirements.
